_note: Attribution for every image on the site. For the CC BY-SA photographs this is a licence CONDITION, not a courtesy — the credit must appear wherever the image does, which is why the generator renders a credit line on the hero and builds /credits/ from this file. Both CC BY-SA images below were resized, cropped to 3:2 and colour-graded; under share-alike those modified versions are themselves CC BY-SA 2.0, which is stated here and on the credits page.

fish-crab.jpg.title: Dungeness crabs
fish-crab.jpg.author: Oregon Department of Fish & Wildlife
fish-crab.jpg.used_for: Dungeness crab, shellfish and steaming pages
fish-crab.jpg.modified: Resized, cropped to 3:2, colour-graded. The modified image is likewise CC BY-SA 2.0.
fish-crab.jpg.why: Live Oregon Dungeness photographed by the state agency that manages the fishery — the most authentic crab image available under a free licence.

shop-smoked.jpg.title: Sides of salmon on racks in a smoking chamber
shop-smoked.jpg.author: Juerg Vollmer
shop-smoked.jpg.used_for: Smoked fish shop category and the smoking method pages
shop-smoked.jpg.modified: Resized, cropped to 3:2, colour-graded. The modified image is likewise CC BY-SA 2.0.
shop-smoked.jpg.why: A working smokehouse rather than a styled plate — it shows the process the smoked line actually comes from.

hero-harbor.jpg.title: Working harbour at first light
hero-harbor.jpg.used_for: Home, About, Charleston and season pages
hero-harbor.jpg.why: No free-licensed photograph of a Pacific Northwest commercial harbour met the bar. Candidates were amateur snapshots, a painting, or boats from the wrong coast carrying legible names and registration numbers.

fish-salmon.jpg.title: Salmon on flake ice
fish-salmon.jpg.why: The free-licensed alternatives were plated restaurant dinners and fish trimmings in a metal bowl on concrete.

fish-halibut.jpg.title: Halibut steaks on ice
fish-halibut.jpg.why: Free-licensed halibut imagery is almost entirely 19th-century scientific engravings.

fish-oysters.jpg.title: Oysters on the half shell
fish-oysters.jpg.why: Free-licensed oyster photography is mostly white-background specimen cutouts.

loc-market.jpg.title: Market stalls before opening
loc-market.jpg.why: Every free-licensed fish-market photograph showed a DIFFERENT named business's storefront and signage, or identifiable customers. Using those on this site would misrepresent a competitor's premises as Brandywine's.

scene-coast.jpg.title: Oregon coastline in fog
scene-coast.jpg.why: Free-licensed Oregon coast photography exists and is decent, but did not beat this frame once graded to the palette.

tex-ice.jpg.title: Crushed ice macro
tex-ice.jpg.why: Free-licensed 'ice' results were cocktails, ice-cube trays and a dog.

scene-bend.jpg.title: Central Oregon high desert
scene-bend.jpg.why: Free-licensed candidates were Washington Cascades and the Seattle/Bellevue skyline — the wrong region entirely.

scene-valley.jpg.title: Willamette Valley farmland in winter rain
scene-valley.jpg.why: No free-licensed frame matched the season and mood needed.
